source.what: 41 consecutive VAD segments of real dictation (~4 minutes), pasted by Zach out of the voice bar's own per-segment event log after segment #41 was classified as :cancel and destroyed the whole draft. Whisper large-v3-turbo transcripts, verbatim, including its punctuation and casing.
source.why: The 344-clip §5.1.1 corpus is ONE synthetic voice reading a fixed script. It cannot cover what a person actually says, and this transcript is the proof: it produced a cancel false positive on the first long real session. 40 sentences of ordinary speech is a better adversarial sample than anything in the corpus, so it is kept.
